title: Identification of common-stage smooth operations with comparison-based descent
statement:
Fix the datum $p,a,q,k_0,k,\ell,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ of [def-pur-conventions]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be smooth separated of pure relative dimension $d\geq0$ between separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Distinguish the framework rational stages $\mathcal C^s_E(W)$, strict-tower transitions $S_{F/E,W}$ and pair categories $\mathcal C_W$ [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi, def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients] from the PBC rational stages $\mathcal C^p_E(W)$, ordinary-tensor transitions $T_{F/E,W}$ and pair categories $\mathcal P_W$ [def-weil-pbc-rational-category, prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension, def-weil-pbc-qbar-category]. Use the canonical exact equivalences $J_{W,E},J_W$ and scalar comparisons $j_{W,F/E}=Q_F(\chi^{-1})$ of [lem-pur-framework-pbc-coefficient-category-comparison], for $W=X,Y$.

Write $H^s_E=Lf_E^*(-)(d)[2d]$ and $G^s_E=Rf_E^!$ for the framework rational operations, and $H^s=Lf^*(-)(d)[2d]$, $G^s=Rf^!$ for the actual operations on $\mathcal C_Y\to\mathcal C_X$ of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom, def-coefficient-twists-detailed, def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. Let $H^p_E,G^p_E$ be the same localized integral operations in the PBC finite-stage presentation, with their canonical finite-stage exact identifications
$$r^H_E:J_{X,E}H^s_E\xrightarrow{\sim}H^p_EJ_{Y,E},\qquad r^G_E:J_{X,E}G^s_E\xrightarrow{\sim}G^p_EJ_{Y,E}.$$
These are identities after the common integral coefficient-presentation identification. Let $a_{F/E}:T_{F/E,X}H^p_E\xrightarrow{\sim}H^p_FT_{F/E,Y}$ and $b_{F/E}:T_{F/E,X}G^p_E\xrightarrow{\sim}G^p_FT_{F/E,Y}$ be the localized ordinary-tensor pullback/twist/shift comparison and counit-preserving exceptional mate of [lem-pur-rational-scalar-comparison-identification].

Let $\overline H,\overline G:\mathcal P_Y\to\mathcal P_X$ be their exact descents [prop-weil-pbc-descent-functors]. There are canonical exact natural isomorphisms of functors $\mathcal C_Y\to\mathcal P_X$
$$R_H:J_XH^s\xrightarrow{\sim}\overline HJ_Y,\qquad R_G:J_XG^s\xrightarrow{\sim}\overline GJ_Y.$$
At $(E,K)$ their components are the classes of $r^H_E,r^G_E$, with the canonical scalar and tensor unitors inserted in the object formulas for $H^s$. In particular the self-extension $S_{E/E}$ is removed by its completeness unitor, not a literal equality. For a PBC representative $v:T_{M/E,Y}A\to T_{M/F,Y}B$, the two descended actions are
$$[M,a_{M/F,B}^{-1}H^p_M(v)a_{M/E,A}],\qquad[M,b_{M/F,B}^{-1}G^p_M(v)b_{M/E,A}].$$
For a framework representative $u:S_{M/E,Y}K\to S_{M/F,Y}L$, these formulas apply to
$$v=j_{Y,M/F,L}J_{Y,M}(u)j_{Y,M/E,K}^{-1},$$
and agree, via $R_H,R_G$, with $J_X$ applied to the defining arrow actions of $H^s,G^s$. Thus the strict-tower operation comparisons are identified with $a,b$ after $\chi$-conjugation. The formulas are independent of the representative and of enlargement of $M$ and respect the specified shifts.

If exact natural transformations $\theta_E:H^p_E\Rightarrow G^p_E$ satisfy
$$b_{F/E}\circ T_{F/E,X}(\theta_E)=\theta_FT_{F/E,Y}\circ a_{F/E},$$
the descended component at $(E,A)\in\mathcal P_Y$ is $[E,\theta_{E,A}]$. On framework finite stages put
$$\theta^s_E=(r^G_E)^{-1}\circ(\theta_EJ_{Y,E})\circ r^H_E,$$
interpreting this arrow through the fully faithful $J_{X,E}$. The corresponding transformation $\theta^s:H^s\Rightarrow G^s$ satisfies
$$J_X(\theta^s)=R_G^{-1}\circ(\overline\theta J_Y)\circ R_H.$$
Equations of compatible transformations retain their finite-stage representatives and identities. In particular, if $\psi_E$ is inverse to $\theta_E$ and satisfies the inverse coefficient square, the descended composites at $(E,A)$ are $[E,\psi_{E,A}\theta_{E,A}]=[E,1]$ and $[E,\theta_{E,A}\psi_{E,A}]=[E,1]$; the conjugate framework transformations are inverse as well.

tool_uses.why: Generic descent of a scalar-compatible family and its transformations; the purity unit specializes this existing coefficient-calculus tool.
Generic common-stage equality and shift calculus; it supplies the meaning of equality of representatives, without replacing any purity step.
The existing integral presentation and mixed scalar comparison identifies the specified pullback/tensor maps; no such presentation comparison is supplied by the transport unit.
Identifies the actual strict twist comparison as chi-conjugation of balanced ordinary tensor; a generic coefficient construction, not a purity theorem.
The chain-level sign-normalized compatibility of completion with shifts; generic coefficient calculus.
Supplies the actual system-level exceptional coefficient comparison used by the exceptional definition.
Pins that system comparison to the counit transpose, so the strict mate comparison is identified as a map rather than by object values.
Generic transport of a specified right-adjoint coefficient mate under chi, including its unit and counit identities.
Pins the ordinary compact-support scalar comparison to the actual compatible finite coefficient maps; needed to compare its exceptional counit mate with the strict-system mate.
